propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled with classifications inferred from structural signals: reverts of STATUS/COMMITS events → regression, plan-review BLOCK verdicts → plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR records → env_integration, otherwise → undetermined.

Backfilled records are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson as git-tracked NDJSON with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregating them from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill script is idempotent by ticket_id: it skips bugs already present in the artifact or carrying authoritative close_class in reduced state, and supports --dry-run mode.
Reverts of COMMENT/LINK events do not trigger regression classification; only substantive reverts (target_event_type STATUS or COMMITS) qualify.

plan-review BLOCK signals are read via all_review_results (schema-guarded for plan_review_result_v2); gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scanning of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files.

Test coverage (tests/scripts/test_backfill_bug_class.py and test_backfill_bug_class_heldout.py) asserts exact close_class values for regression, plan_defect, env_integration, and undetermined cases, plus idempotence and authoritative-value protection.
